versions.changelog: Add transcript-derived control-plane policies for confidence-margin routing, fail-closed tool-risk assessment, and weighted rubric judging; document the LangChain harness patterns and add offline safety tests.

Add Von, LitJev, and Simple-JEV native providers; add provider capability metadata, deployment-bound temperature calibration, Noul reliability metrics, Score integrity checks, matched report comparison, and ecosystem research.
Add LangChain TypeSafeClassifier guidance, routed-model middleware patterns, pre-tool risk-gating guidance, an optional LangChain example, and explicit hosted-versus-local provider boundaries.
Add OpenJev-HF Hugging Face checkpoint support through SGLang /classify, NLI-to-typed decision conversion, explicit calibration warnings, and model-card research guidance.
Add native LocalJev provider support, TypeScript/Bun DiffusionGemma bridge guidance, prompted-probability calibration warnings, and LocalJev regression coverage.
Add native OpenJev provider support, local Apple-Silicon/MLX setup, JevBench references, calibration guidance, and OpenJev regression coverage.
Add production state-size and warning-rate guardrails, an open-source repository test suite, and GitHub Actions CI.
Add ClawHub skill card and retain the local-model, ensemble, verifier, abstention, calibration, and research hardening from 1.3.0.
Add local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends, schema-constrained decoding, self-consistency ensembles, verifier/abstention, Wilson intervals, and deep local-model research.
Deep research hardening: pinned-model guidance, request IDs, retry telemetry, context-rot/adversarial slices, calibration metrics, tagged cases, and stronger response validation.
Add a dependency-free typed evaluation harness for Noul, Choice, and Score golden sets with validation, retries, concurrency, accuracy, confidence, latency, and token reports.
Initial Jev Skill: current TypeSafe research, typed question design, confidence-aware routing, API/SDK guidance, and evaluation guardrails.
